PianJian_zone11.additionalInfo: The point does not appear in Master Tung's original book. Hu Wen Zhi first introduced it. Pian Jian, like Mu Hua (II), innervates the spleen and liver. Both points are located on the second segment, representing the middle burner where the spleen and liver are situated. Mu Hua treats calf cramps, while Pian Jian affects the upper limbs. Point Name Piän [1B] — To deviate, to lean to the opposite side. Jiän [B] - Shoulder. The name of the point suggests its ability to treat shoulder disorders.
